items.title: Exactness of the skyscraper functor at a point of a ringed topos, and the non-linearity of its direct sum decomposition
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-modules.tex (Modules on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file sites-modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves three facts about the pushforward along a point p of a ringed topos: exactness of p_* on modules, linearity of the canonical surjection p^{-1}p_*M -> M, and the failure in general of linearity for the functorial direct sum decomposition known for abelian sheaves. Parts (1) and the surjectivity in (2) are reduced to the abelian-sheaves version of the same statement, and linearity of the counit follows from the identification p^{-1}O = O_p, which makes p^{-1} = p^* so that the map in question is the adjunction counit for modules (proof lines 7298-7308). Part (3) is proved by an explicit counterexample: for a group G one considers the topos of G-sets with its point to Sets, where p^{-1} forgets the action and p_* is the right adjoint Map(G, -), and the maps in the direct sum decomposition are displayed and shown not to be O_p-linear (proof lines 7309-7336). H2: the reduction for parts (1) and (2) and the explicit counterexample for part (3) are the substance.
